import pytest
from store.cart import Cart, Item
from store.coupons import CouponError


def test_issue_save10_two_lines():
    """A percent coupon takes that percent off the whole subtotal."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="mug", name="Mug", price_cents=1200))
    cart.add(Item(sku="shirt", name="T-Shirt", price_cents=2500))
    cart.apply_coupon("SAVE10")
    assert cart.discount_cents() == 370  # 3700*10//100 = 370


def test_issue_save10_quantities():
    """Percent coupons must apply to every line, including quantities."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="mug", name="Mug", price_cents=1200))
    cart.add(Item(sku="mug", name="Mug", price_cents=1200))
    cart.add(Item(sku="shirt", name="T-Shirt", price_cents=2500))
    cart.apply_coupon("SAVE10")
    assert cart.discount_cents() == 490  # (1200*2+2500)=4900; 4900*10//100=490


def test_issue_halfoff_whole_subtotal():
    """A percent coupon takes that percent off the whole subtotal."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="mug", name="Mug", price_cents=1200))
    cart.add(Item(sku="shirt", name="T-Shirt", price_cents=2500))
    cart.apply_coupon("HALFOFF")
    assert cart.discount_cents() == 1850  # 3700*50//100 = 1850


def test_issue_percent_rounds_down_on_whole():
    """A percent coupon takes that percent off the whole subtotal, rounded down to the cent."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="a", name="A", price_cents=105))
    cart.add(Item(sku="b", name="B", price_cents=105))
    cart.apply_coupon("SAVE10")
    assert cart.discount_cents() == 21  # 210*10//100 = 21


def test_issue_percent_total_includes_all_lines():
    """total = discounted subtotal + shipping + tax, and is never negative."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="mug", name="Mug", price_cents=1200))
    cart.add(Item(sku="shirt", name="T-Shirt", price_cents=2500))
    cart.apply_coupon("SAVE10")
    assert cart.total_cents() == 4195  # 3330+599+266 = 4195


def test_contract_subtotal():
    """Subtotal is the sum of price_cents * qty over every line in the cart."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="a", name="A", price_cents=500, qty=3))
    cart.add(Item(sku="b", name="B", price_cents=700, qty=2))
    assert cart.subtotal_cents() == 2900  # 500*3+700*2 = 1500+1400 = 2900


def test_contract_second_coupon_raises():
    """At most one coupon may be applied to a cart."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="mug", name="Mug", price_cents=1200))
    cart.apply_coupon("SAVE10")
    with pytest.raises(CouponError):
        cart.apply_coupon("FIVEOFF")


def test_contract_fixed_minimum():
    """A fixed coupon takes a flat amount off, but only when the subtotal is at least the coupon's minimum."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="mug", name="Mug", price_cents=1200))
    cart.apply_coupon("FIVEOFF")
    assert cart.discount_cents() == 0  # 1200 < 2000 so 0


def test_contract_fixed_capped_to_subtotal():
    """The discount can never exceed the subtotal."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="cheap", name="Cheap", price_cents=500))
    cart.apply_coupon("TENOFF")
    assert cart.discount_cents() == 500  # min(1000, 500) = 500


def test_contract_shipping_free_at_threshold():
    """Shipping is free when the discounted subtotal is $50.00 or more."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="shirt", name="T-Shirt", price_cents=2500, qty=2))
    assert cart.shipping_cents() == 0  # 5000 >= 5000 so 0


def test_contract_shipping_below_threshold():
    """Shipping is free when the discounted subtotal is $50.00 or more; otherwise it is a flat $5.99."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="mug", name="Mug", price_cents=1200))
    cart.add(Item(sku="shirt", name="T-Shirt", price_cents=2500))
    assert cart.shipping_cents() == 599  # 0 < 3700 < 5000 so 599


def test_contract_shipping_empty():
    """An empty cart has no shipping charge."""
    cart = Cart()
    assert cart.shipping_cents() == 0  # empty so 0


def test_contract_tax_half_up():
    """Tax is 8% of the discounted subtotal, rounded half up to the cent."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="c", name="C", price_cents=333))
    assert cart.tax_cents() == 27  # (333*8+50)//100 = 2714//100 = 27


def test_contract_total_formula():
    """total = discounted subtotal + shipping + tax, and is never negative."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="mug", name="Mug", price_cents=1200))
    cart.add(Item(sku="shirt", name="T-Shirt", price_cents=2500))
    assert cart.total_cents() == 4595  # 3700+599+296 = 4595
